title.en: An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Amending Certain Items of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-Three Hundred and One, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works and for Other Purposes”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2869_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 3 条，缺 2）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
On page 154 of Republic Act Numbered Twenty-three hundred and one, item (23) under Group II (Projects for the Second District, Negros Oriental), embraced by subsection c (Re implementation of Republic Act Numbered Eight hundred thirty-six, as amended), is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(23) Central Primary School Building, Siquijor—Improvement ₱5,000.00"
Section 2. On page 441 of the same Act, item (k) under Group II (Projects for the Second District, Negros Oriental), under subsection d of Section two thereof, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(k) Central Primary School, Siquijor—Aid to PTA for improvement ₱5,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
